{{Top|leg}}
'''Moagwood''' was a type of wood used to make [[Wine/Legends|wine]] casks. Moagwood aging casks were essential in making a potent [[Maldovean Burtalle]].<ref name="vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>
